page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 96.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, alongside an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage, consisting of 70,866 GB of HDD capacity. This high-density storage profile makes it highly cost-efficient for applications requiring massive data capacity without the premium cost of solid-state drives. However, because the storage relies on HDD technology rather than NVMe or SSDs, workloads will experience lower random IOPS and higher latency, representing a clear tradeoff between storage volume and raw I/O speed.

Given these hardware parameters, the ecs.d1.6xlarge is optimized for workloads that demand large-scale sequential data access and high storage density. Suitable use cases include big data analytics, MapReduce jobs, data warehousing, large-scale log processing, and cold storage archives where capacity is prioritized over low-latency disk performance.
